name: AI Driven Content
author: Holoultek

sections.description:
AI Driven Content is a powerful tool that integrates with your WordPress editor to generate high-quality content with a single click. The plugin connects to DeepSeek’s AI API to create engaging, SEO-friendly content based on your prompts.

Features:

  • Generate content directly in the WordPress editor
  • Works with both Classic and Gutenberg editors
  • Customize the AI system message for different content styles
  • Language detection to match your post’s title language
  • Simple and intuitive interface

External services

This plugin connects to the Deepseek API to generate AI content. The API is used to provide the following functionality:
– Creating AI-generated content for posts and pages, or any other content with text editor.

Data sent to the Deepseek API includes:
– User’s content input
– Settings configured by the user

This data is sent when:
– A user initiates AI content generation

This service is provided by Deepseek: Terms of use, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-content-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > AI Driven Content to add your DeepSeek API key
  4. Start generating content in your posts and pages
sections.faq:
1. Do I need an API key to use this plugin?
    Yes, you need a DeepSeek API key. You can get one from DeepSeek’s website.

  2. Does it work with Gutenberg editor?
    Yes, the plugin supports both the Classic editor and Gutenberg.
